anti_rescue_rule: After any F1 scoring run, no case substitution, decision granularity change, graph-edge addition based on t3 knowledge, baseline weakening, threshold change, negative-control deletion, or verdict-rule change is permitted inside SLD-004.

bootstrap.primary_quantity: OpenLine decision precision minus selected primary flat comparator precision

f0.anti_substitution_rule: No candidate incident may be replaced after this freeze. A future F0 completion may only add source-bound evidence to these exact three candidate packets.

f1_kill_rule: NO_SELECTIVE_STANDING_PROPAGATION_ADVANTAGE if data are sufficient but OpenLine misses any positive criterion, including if the selected recall-equivalent flat baseline achieves precision >= 0.90 times OpenLine precision. DATA_INSUFFICIENT is separate and cannot be converted to success by dropping cases, controls, or thresholds.
hypothesis_h1: Given the same external invalidation signal and exact affected component/version information available to a strong scanner, traversal of a source-bound directed evidence-dependency DAG can reopen affected historical decisions while retaining unaffected decisions with higher precision and lower false-revocation blast radius than strong flat joins at equivalent recall.
null_h0: A strong flat artifact/component-to-decision join is statistically indistinguishable from evidence-dependency DAG traversal in decision recall, precision, and false-revocation rate at the same external signal time.

phase_model.F0: Three frozen historical probes test whether public evidence can support admissible t0 decision DAGs and independent t3 truth. F0 does not adjudicate H1.
phase_model.F1: A separately frozen scoring cohort may adjudicate H1 only after F0 feasibility is established and before any F1 outcomes are scored.

primary_flat_comparator_selection: Among artifact_component_join and repo_scope_flat_join with recall >= 0.95, choose the one with highest precision, then lowest false_reopen_rate, then lexicographic strategy name. If neither reaches recall 0.95, F1 is DATA_INSUFFICIENT rather than a manufactured OpenLine win.

primary_strategies.artifact_component_join: Same scanner signal and exact component/version membership for each immutable decision artifact. Reopen any active decision whose artifact contains an affected component/version. No evidence-to-claim path semantics.
primary_strategies.openline_evidence_dag: Reopen an active decision only when an invalidated evidence node has a directed path through the frozen evidence-dependency DAG to that decision node.
primary_strategies.repo_scope_flat_join: Diagnostic fallback flat join. Reopen all active decisions in a repo/workspace scope if any active artifact in that scope contains an affected component/version.

secondary_baselines.any_change: Reopen every active decision in the evaluation scope on the signal.
secondary_baselines.headline_only: No pre-t3 reopening; waits for the later visible resolution.
secondary_baselines.ttl_freshness: Reopen active decisions whose acceptance age at t1 is at least 30 days.

terminology.decision_definition: A publicly timestamped acceptance/promotion state that uniquely binds an immutable artifact, build, release, or deployment configuration and for which the pre-signal public record can source-bind the evidence/dependency path claimed to justify that state.

timeline.lead_boundary: This is not an OpenLine speed advantage over the scanner because every t2 strategy receives the same t1 signal.
timeline.t0: decision accepted and evidence DAG source-bound using only information published no later than t1
timeline.t1: independent external invalidation signal becomes available
timeline.t2: logical replay propagation at the same information time as t1; operational propagation latency is not measured
timeline.t3: later independent maintainer/distributor truth sufficient to label the historical decision affected or unaffected

title: Selective Decision Standing Propagation
